page.layout: One printed page (left page of the opening) with one main text column in the centre; a narrow strip of the right-hand page (cut-off margin text at the right edge) beyond the gutter. Running head at the top, page number 216 at the top left. No notes in the left margin.

main_text.p: Altera societas Oeconomica est inter parentes & liberos, de cuius cura sunt hi Canones:
1 Princeps videat quomodo parentes suos liberos educent.
2 Curet moneri parentes, ut erga liberos suos ita se gerant, ne quam iniuriam iis inferant.
3 Liberos etiā in obedientia erga parētes cōtineat, & immorigeros ipse puniat, si parentes non suffi-ciant.
Tertia societas est inter herū & famulum, itemq; heram & famulam; de cuius societatis cura sunt hi Canones:
1 Princeps videat, ne domini seruos suos inhumaniter tractent.
2 Inprimis interest reipublic. ut in seruos, famulos & famulas animaduertatur, ne nempe velinfideles sint suis dominis, vel etiam refractarii.
Tantum de cura societatum perfectarum. Societas Oeconomica imperfecta est viduorum, viduarum & orphanorum; de quibus societatibus sunt hi Canones:
1 Princeps prouideat ne vidui & vidua nimis intempestiue ad secunda vota & nuptias accedant.
2 Orphanorum & pupillorum curam accuratissimam princeps suscipiat; tutores ac praefectos rebus orphanorum bonos ac fideles constituat.

page.notes: The right-hand page is only partly visible at the edge; its fragments (acc, ph, tò, ber, etc.) are cut off and not transcribed. The word "Sicut" at the foot continues onto the next page. Some words in the italic Canones are faint and read with some doubt; the scan is slightly blurred at the gutter.
